title: A perspective on the molecular simulation of DNA from structural and functional aspects.
authors: Mondal, Manas; Yang, Lijiang; Cai, Zhicheng; Patra, Piya; Gao, Yi Qin
one_liner_zh: 该文综述了从原子尺度模拟DNA结构动态及其与蛋白结合（含TF）的多尺度机制，虽为视角性综述但聚焦蛋白-DNA互作与基因调控，方法上以分子模拟为核心，对本课题有直接参考价值。
abstract: As genetic material, DNA not only carries genetic information by sequence, but also affects biological functions ranging from base modification to replication, transcription and gene regulation through its structural and dynamic properties and variations. The motion and structural properties of DNA involved in related biological processes are also multi-scale, ranging from single base flipping to local DNA deformation, TF binding, G-quadruplex and i-motif formation, TAD establishment, compartmentalization and even chromosome territory formation, just to name a few. The sequence-dependent physical properties of DNA play vital role in all these events, and thus it is interesting to examine how simple sequence information affects DNA and the formation of the chromatin structure in these different hierarchical orders. Accordingly, molecular simulations can provide atomistic details of interactions and conformational dynamics involved in different biological processes of DNA, including those inaccessible by current experimental methods. In this perspective, which is mainly based on our recent studies, we provide a brief overview of the atomistic simulations on how the hierarchical structure and dynamics of DNA can be influenced by its sequences, base modifications, environmental factors and protein binding in the context of the protein-DNA interactions, gene regulation and structural organization of chromatin. We try to connect the DNA sequence, the hierarchical structures of DNA and gene regulation.
abstract_zh: 作为遗传物质，DNA不仅通过序列携带遗传信息，还通过其结构和动态特性及变化影响从碱基修饰到复制、转录和基因调控等生物功能。相关生物过程中涉及的DNA运动和结构特性也是多尺度的，从单碱基翻转、局部DNA变形、转录因子结合、G-四链体和i-motif形成、TAD建立、区室化乃至染色体领地形成，仅举数例。DNA的序列依赖性物理特性在这些事件中起着至关重要的作用，因此，探究简单序列信息如何影响DNA以及这些不同层级顺序中染色质结构的形成，颇具意义。相应地，分子模拟能够提供DNA不同生物过程中涉及的相互作用和构象动态的原子级细节，包括当前实验方法无法触及的部分。基于我们近期的研究，本展望简要概述了原子模拟如何揭示DNA的层级结构和动态受其序列、碱基修饰、环境因素及蛋白质结合的影响，特别是在蛋白质-DNA相互作用、基因调控和染色质结构组织的背景下。我们试图将DNA序列、DNA的层级结构与基因调控联系起来。
